name: LEC Inc
summary: LEC, Inc. operates as a Japanese manufacturer and international supplier of household goods. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses a diverse range of home essentials, including sanitary items for bathrooms, dressing rooms, and toilets; merchandise for children and infants; various hooks and interior organization solutions; kitchenware and dining accessories; laundry care items; and personal care products, in addition to a variety of cleaning agents and detergents. Established in 1979, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
